computed_metric_value_note: zero rather than null: the metric layer ran and produced no value because no benchmark was executed. Every metric is NOT_EXECUTED or BLOCKED, never a numeric zero.
development_is_not_validation: The 7 development cases are a regression signal. They shaped the software and are structurally excluded from every validation denominator; results derived from them appear only under DEVELOPMENT_REGRESSION.
implementation_note: The metric registry, the benchmark contract, the engine, the public report and the dashboard feed are implemented. That is a statement about software. Whether any release has been validated is the separate question below, and the answer is no.
not_clinical_validation: This document describes metric machinery and its current empty state. It is not clinical validation, scientific validation or expert review, and no number in it establishes that the system is safe for any patient.
reference_judgment_note: WP-18 stores no expected answer. A reference judgment is a separate immutable input with its own provenance; none has been supplied, so concordance-style metrics are NO_REFERENCE_JUDGMENT rather than zero.
threshold_note: No metric carries a threshold. One would require a predeclared, reviewable policy with provenance, and none exists.
